name: Jean-Marc Germain - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers - EGF/2025/000 TA 2025 - Technical assistance at the initiative of the Commission
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to release 170,000 euros from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for 2025. This money is not paid to workers. It covers the European Commission's own costs of running the fund: meetings with national contact points, a networking seminar, a website, computer systems for handling applications, and collecting data. The Parliament also asks the Commission to keep inviting it to these meetings, keep the fund's website up to date, and check that countries publicise the help they give.

- 170,000 euros released for the Commission to run the fund in 2025.
- Affects the Commission, national contact points and social partners, not workers directly.
- Parliament approves the decision; its President signs it with the Council, then it is published.
